description: Comment thread component with inline rich text editing via TmRichEditorSimple. Supports adding, editing, and deleting comments with author avatars, relative timestamps, and edit indicators. Communicates changes via EventCallbacks. Exposes a draft-guard surface: OnDraftChanged reports every TmCommentDraftState transition (editor open/closed, which comment is edited, whether unsaved content exists) with value-equality dedup, HasUnsavedDraft polls the same flag at any time, and DiscardDraftAsync closes the editor after the consumer's own confirmation. CommentActions is an optional per-comment RenderFragment<TmCommentEntry> rendered after Edit/Delete inside .tm-comment-actions, wrapped by .tm-comment-actions__custom; the consumer supplies the button and any confirmation dialog. The actions row is omitted when the comment cannot be edited or deleted and CommentActions is unset, and it is hidden on the comment currently being edited. The wrapper is not focusable and handles no keys. Each comment item carries data-comment-id (the entry id) and data-internal="true|false". An internal entry also gets tm-comment-item--internal and a lock TmBadge (IconNames.Lock plus the localized Internal label; the explanatory title is repeated in a tm-sr-only span, not an aria-label). Each rendered consumer badge carries data-badge-tone (neutral|info|success|warning|danger|accent) and, when Title is set, the same tm-sr-only ": {Title}" pattern. The component never hides an internal comment.

parameters.name: Comments
parameters.description: Comments to render. An entry with IsInternal is painted with the internal wash, IconNames.Lock and the localized Internal label; it is never hidden — the consumer or server filters visibility. Valid Badges render in the meta row as subtle pill TmBadges. A null Badges list is treated as empty. Defaults to an empty list.

parameters.name: CommentSubmitHandler
parameters.description: Optional save handler for a NEW comment. When set, it runs INSTEAD of OnCommentSubmitted and OnCommentAdded. Return true: the editor closes and clears and the internal switch resets. Return false: the editor stays open with the typed text and the internal-switch state preserved, the aria-live status announces the non-save (the consumer presents the actual reason), and no draft transition is reported. The handler converts its own failures to false — an exception propagates (the in-flight flag still clears in finally and the editor stays open). Null keeps the legacy callbacks, order unchanged.

parameters.name: OnCommentAdded
parameters.description: Raised with the submitted HTML when the user posts a new comment. Stays for hosts that only need the body. Prefer OnCommentSubmitted when the host must also know whether the composer was in internal mode — that callback fires first, then this one, with the same HTML. Both stay; neither replaces the other. Neither runs when CommentSubmitHandler is set — the handler replaces them.

parameters.name: OnCommentSubmitted
parameters.description: Raised when the user posts a NEW comment, before OnCommentAdded, with the HTML and the composer internal flag (TmCommentSubmission). Document order is fixed: this callback, then OnCommentAdded. An edit does not raise it. An effectively empty composer raises neither callback. When this callback has no delegate, only OnCommentAdded runs. Neither runs when CommentSubmitHandler is set — the handler replaces them.

parameters.name: SupportsMentions
parameters.description: Passes mention autocomplete through to the new-comment composer and the inline editor. Without MentionProvider the editor stays off even when this is true — no exception, no empty picker. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: People source for the composer and inline-editor mention picker. Null (or SupportsMentions false) leaves autocomplete off.

parameters.name: ShowInternalToggle
parameters.description: Shows the internal switch (TmToggle, role=switch, localized TmActivityComments_InternalToggle) in the new-comment composer footer. Off by default. The inline editor never shows it. After a successful post, cancel, or DiscardDraftAsync the switch returns to off. It is disabled while the post is in flight. On paints tm-comment-editor--internal.

parameters.name: OnCommentDeleted
parameters.description: Raised with the comment id when the user deletes a comment.

parameters.name: CommentEditHandler
parameters.description: Optional save handler for an inline edit. When set, it runs INSTEAD of OnCommentEdited, with the same data in a named TmCommentEdit record (CommentId, Html). Return true: the inline editor closes. Return false: the inline editor stays open with the edited text and the dirty draft state is preserved; the consumer presents the reason. The handler converts its own failures to false — an exception propagates (the in-flight flag still clears in finally and the editor stays open). Null keeps OnCommentEdited, behavior unchanged.

parameters.name: OnCommentEdited
parameters.description: Raised with the comment id and the new HTML when the user saves an edit. Does not run when CommentEditHandler is set — the handler replaces it.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the TmCommentDraftState value changes — editor opened/closed, the edited comment changed, or HasUnsavedContent flipped (e.g. first character typed, edit reverted to the original). Value-equality deduped, so it does NOT fire on every keystroke. Consumers use TmCommentDraftState to build a dirty-guard before discarding an in-progress comment; the record carries flags only, never the draft text.

parameters.name: ShowAddButton
parameters.description: Shows the Add comment button when no editor is open. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: CommentActions
parameters.description: Consumer actions rendered after the built-in Edit and Delete buttons, inside .tm-comment-actions wrapped by .tm-comment-actions__custom, once per comment with that comment's TmCommentEntry. The component does not interpret the fragment: the consumer supplies its own button and any confirmation dialog (for example an admin toggle between internal and public). The component never hides an internal comment. The actions row renders when the comment can be edited or deleted, or when this fragment is set; it is omitted when none of those apply. While that comment is being edited inline the row is hidden; other comments keep theirs. The wrapper is not focusable and does not handle keys, so it does not change tab order — put a native button in the fragment.

methods.name: DiscardDraftAsync
methods.description: Closes the open editor (new comment or inline edit) and clears its content. Intended for the consumer AFTER the user confirmed the discard in the consumer's own confirmation dialog — the component never shows one itself. A deliberate no-op when nothing is open; doubles as recovery when the comment being edited was removed from Comments by a parent refresh.

methods.name: RefreshAsync
methods.description: Re-renders the component — parents can await this after updating Comments.

methods.name: SetEditorContentForTestAsync
methods.description: Test seam: injects editor content without JS and awaits the draft notification, mirroring the real typing path (ValueChanged → OnDraftChanged). The void SetEditorContentForTest(string) overload keeps its signature for existing callers and runs the same notification fire-and-forget.

properties.name: HasUnsavedDraft
properties.description: Whether the component currently holds an unsaved comment draft — the same value the OnDraftChanged HasUnsavedContent flag carries, read live from the current editor state so consumers can poll it at any time (e.g. before a refresh that would discard the draft). Read it on the component's dispatcher (an event handler or InvokeAsync) from background threads.

domAttributes.name: data-comment-id
domAttributes.description: The comment entry id. Present on every rendered item.

domAttributes.name: data-internal
domAttributes.description: "true" when the entry is internal, otherwise "false". Always present; never omitted.

domAttributes.name: data-badge-tone
domAttributes.description: Lower-cased TmCommentBadgeTone of a rendered consumer badge: neutral, info, success, warning, danger or accent. Not set on the internal lock badge.

examples.title: Host action per comment (button + confirmation dialog)
examples.description: CommentActions receives the entry. The dialog and the IsInternal flip belong to the host; the component only paints the result and never hides an internal comment.
examples.code:
<TmActivityComments Comments="@comments"
                     CommentActions="@VisibilityAction" />
<TmDialog Show="@_confirm" Type="DialogType.Confirm"
          Title="Change visibility?"
          Message="Notifications already sent cannot be recalled."
          OnResult="ApplyVisibility" />

@code {
    private RenderFragment<TmCommentEntry> VisibilityAction => comment => __builder =>
    {
        <TmButton Variant="ButtonVariant.Ghost" Size="ButtonSize.Sm" Icon="@IconNames.Lock"
                  OnClick="@(() => Ask(comment))">Toggle</TmButton>
    };
}

examples.title: Dirty-guard from OnDraftChanged before a page refresh
examples.description: The record carries flags only — never the draft text. Dedup guarantees the callback does not fire on every keystroke.
examples.code:
<TmActivityComments Comments="@comments"
                     OnCommentAdded="HandleAdd"
                     OnCommentDeleted="HandleDelete"
                     OnCommentEdited="HandleEdit"
                     OnDraftChanged="HandleDraftChanged" />

@code {
    private TmCommentDraftState _draft = new(false, null, false);

    private void HandleDraftChanged(TmCommentDraftState state) => _draft = state;

    private async Task ReloadAsync()
    {
        // Dirty-guard: ask before a refresh would throw the in-progress comment away.
        // For an edit, HasUnsavedContent means the body differs from the original;
        // for a new comment, that the content is not empty.
        if (_draft.HasUnsavedContent && !await ConfirmDiscardDraftAsync())
        {
            return;
        }

        comments = await api.GetCommentsAsync();
    }
}

examples.title: Discarding an unsaved comment draft via @ref
examples.code:
<TmActivityComments @ref="_comments"
                     Comments="@comments"
                     OnCommentAdded="HandleAdd"
                     OnCommentDeleted="HandleDelete"
                     OnCommentEdited="HandleEdit" />

@code {
    private TmActivityComments? _comments;

    private async Task DiscardUnsavedDraftAsync()
    {
        // HasUnsavedDraft mirrors the OnDraftChanged HasUnsavedContent flag; read it on the
        // component's dispatcher (an event handler or InvokeAsync) from background threads.
        if (_comments is not null && _comments.HasUnsavedDraft && await Confirm())
        {
            await _comments.DiscardDraftAsync();
        }
    }
}
